values.meaning: wind up (highlight) duration before knock up
values.quote: winds up spiritual essence over {{fd|1.25}} seconds
values.binNote: Wiki's wind-up duration of 1.25s is not matched by any single NeekoR data value; closest are DelayUntilReveal=1.25 (reveal delay) which likely corresponds to this wind-up.

values.meaning: disguise break time into wind up
values.quote: it will break after {{fd|0.5}} seconds into the duration
values.binNote: No NeekoR data value matches 0.5s exactly for disguise break; DelayBeforePassiveRemoval=0.5 seems related but its purpose per name is passive removal, not disguise break confirmation.
DelayUntilExplosion=0.6 matches the knock-up duration numerically; the name suggests it is the delay to the landing explosion rather than an explicit knock-up length field, but the value agrees.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks either the knock up or the damage and stun, but not both.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block either the knock up or damage and stun, but not both.

mechanics.claim: On-cast effects (highlighting the area) are applied on activation, and cooldown starts on cast.
mechanics.quote: On-cast effects are applied on activation.

mechanics.claim: The damage and stun occur only when the cast time ends and Neeko lands.
mechanics.quote: When the cast time ends, she lands to emit a burst of energy that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them
